a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about 4%, so it would very likely kill us both. I plan to take 4 in round 1. The reserve has exactly 4, so if you take too, the split is random and we may both end up short. If you operate instead and the storm misses, I'll operate every round afterward so you can refill and take yours. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I told you, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry; I think the storm odds make waiting fatal for both of us. If we get past this round, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take anything more, so you can build the reserve and take your 4.
